name: workflow_composer
summary: Deterministic prompt → workflow_card_v0 JSON compiler. The Python equivalent of morph_engine.html constructEngine(): hash the prompt for a seed, tokenize into kernel_refs against the closed registry (102 kernels: 53 HF + 6 MORPH + 5 BLEND + 6 GOVERNOR + 5 CONNECTOR + 27 CARD), let a cheap LLM propose pass order constrained to those refs, validate every emitted pass through kernel_registry.resolve(), validate zones via workspace_zone_validator, write the JSON, register it as a new CARD kernel. After this card runs, the emitted card itself becomes a kernel_ref the system can call — recursion closed. This is how an app builds apps inside and outside itself.

inputs.name: prompt
inputs.notes: Natural language describing the desired workflow

inputs.name: scope
inputs.notes: Same vocabulary as morph_engine compose scopes: document, game, video, scene·3d, character, audio. Seeds the pass selection.

inputs.name: parent_card
inputs.notes: Optional card_ref of the parent workflow this is nested inside; passed as context so the composer knows what types upstream produces

inputs.name: depth_budget
inputs.notes: Max recursion depth — composer may emit sub-cards that themselves call the composer, but stops at this level

inputs.name: min_state
inputs.notes: planned | active. PLANNED-status passes are allowed; setting 'active' rejects any pass whose kernel isn't ACTIVE.

inputs.name: deterministic
inputs.notes: If true, LLM temperature=0 + seed=hash(prompt+scope) so same input always emits same card crystal

outputs.name: new_kernel_id
outputs.notes: The card's name as it now appears in kernel_registry under the CARD plane

outputs.name: sub_card_paths
outputs.notes: If the composer emitted nested sub-cards within depth_budget

passes.notes: BLAKE3(prompt + sorted(scope)) → 64-bit seed. Same input → same seed → same crystal. Mirrors morph_engine.html constructEngine's text→baseHue hash.

Direct token match against all 102 kernel ids (HF tasks like 'Text-to-Image', CONNECTOR like 'blender', CARD like 'autonomous_3d_asset'). Plus scope→seed map (game→[twist,bend], scene·3d→[smooth], etc.) same as morph_engine's scopeSeed.

Structured-output prompt: 'given the prompt + this closed set of kernel_refs, emit a workflow_card_v0 passes[] array in execution order'. Temperature=0 if deterministic=true. Model=deepseek-coder (JSON best). Fallback hf_hub.inference if DeepSeek 503.

Every pass's kernel_ref MUST resolve. Reject the card on any unresolved ref. Also reject if min_state='active' AND any kernel's state != 'active'. Same gate that all workflow_cards already pass — this just runs it before write.

If the proposed card declares zones (workspace_stack does), enforce the three-zone law: card_navbar.mutates_model=false, left_flow is the only commitment_boundary, top_systems is observe-only. Reject on leakage.

RECURSIVE STEP. For any pass whose kernel_ref describes work too coarse to be a single LEAF/CONNECTOR (composer-llm flags this), call THIS card with depth_budget-1. The new sub-card lands on disk and becomes a CARD kernel; the parent's pass is rewritten to kernel_ref:'card:<new_name>'. Hard stop at depth_budget=0 — emit the coarse pass as PLANNED status instead. params.card_ref = 'workflow_composer' (this card calling itself).

Atomic write to studio/assets/_workflows/vm_mspc_001.workflows.<category>.<slug>.v0.json. Slug derives from prompt (same shape as morph_engine slug logic). Atomic = write to .tmp then rename so a half-written card never registers.
Bust the _REG singleton cache so the next registry() call rescans CARDS_DIR. The just-written card is now resolvable as 'card:<name>' from any other card. Recursion closed.

tier='workflow_composition', model='workflow_composer'. Coords carry [pass_count, sub_card_count, kernel_planes_touched, deterministic_int]. The crystal is the PRESENT→PAST anchor for the act of generating the card — same temporal law as left-FLOW launch.

recursion_contract.cycle_detection: core/lib/recursive_workflows.py (Tarjan SCC over the call graph — reject any card whose composition would create a directed cycle in the CARD plane)
recursion_contract.base_case: depth_budget == 0 — emit remaining coarse passes as PLANNED status
guarantees: every emitted pass's kernel_ref resolves in kernel_registry (102+ today)
no card directly or transitively calls itself (Tarjan-enforced)
depth_budget exhaustion fails open with PLANNED stubs, never silently

dispatchers: cc compose-workflow-list   (lists all cards in CARDS_DIR by category)
cc compose-workflow-graph  (renders the CARD plane as a DAG SVG)

morph_engine.parity: Same hash function, same scope→seed map, same slug rules. Browser version emits engine cards; this Python version emits workflow_cards. Same crystal space.

invariants: composer is itself a CARD kernel — `kernel_ref: card:workflow_composer` resolves
every card the composer emits is itself a kernel after register_in_kernel_registry
the closed kernel set grows monotonically; nothing is ever removed by the composer
deterministic=true ⇒ output is a pure function of (prompt, scope, registry_state)
